description: This file implements user profile picture handling in Mattermost, including retrieving, generating default images, and file storage management.

methods.name: GetProfileImage
methods.description: Retrieves the user's profile image, either from storage or generates a default if not available.

methods.name: FileBackend
methods.description: Initializes and returns the file storage backend used for profile images.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads a file from the storage backend.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file in the storage backend.

methods.name: GetDefaultProfileImage
methods.description: Generates a default profile image for a user, including bot images and initials-based images.

methods.name: createProfileImage
methods.description: Creates a profile image with initials and background color.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Loads a font file for rendering initials.
